summary.title: Port orphans as an observation (emit-evidence-not-verdict)
summary.what: Added the orphans rule at Corpus altitude as a claim-free Observation (not a verdict). Emits one INVESTIGATE nudge per unreferenced top-level symbol at/above min_confidence (default high), carrying Evidence(kind='orphan'). Consumes Structure.over(corpus).orphans(). Registry 15; 5 tests.
summary.why: The orphans metric flags cross-file-unreferenced symbols (conflating dead with module-private), and static analysis cannot see dynamic dispatch/reflection/external callers — so a dead-code verdict would be an unbacked precision claim. Observation is the honest disposition.

decisions.rationale: Static analysis can't honestly claim dead code; observation makes no precision claim so it can't be a false positive. Dynamic languages cap at medium confidence, so the high default is silent on Python and surfaces only reliable static-language orphans.
rejected: min_confidence=medium default (82 noisy false orphans on the clean tree)
